mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebook (name, category1_id, category2_id, description, cover) VALUES (#{name}, #{category1Id}, #{category2Id}, #{description}, #{cover})
mapper.update: UPDATE ebook SET doc_count = #{docCount}, view_count = #{viewCount}, vote_count = #{voteCount} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ebook e LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ebook_id, COUNT(*) AS doc_count, COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS view_count, COALESCE(SUM(vote_count), 0) AS vote_count FROM doc GROUP BY ebook_id ) s ON e.id = s.ebook_id SET e.doc_count = COALESCE(s.doc_count, 0), e.view_count = COALESCE(s.view_count, 0), e.vote_count = COALESCE(s.vote_count, 0)
